description: A dashboard to show information relevant to the ROCm(tm) AMD Infinity Context System using for KV Cache block management and prefill offload via storage.

panels.description: Total power delivered to the GPU running vLLM. Where possible we include the server power if available.
panels.title: GPU and (Optionally) Server Power

panels.description: The activity factor of the CUs and UMC in the GPU. This is given as a percentage of total compute power avaliable.
panels.title: GPU Activity

panels.description: The amount of VRAM currently in use.
panels.title: VRAM Utilization

panels.description: External prefix cache (LMCache / KV connector) hit ratio from vllm:external_prefix_cache_* counters.
panels.title: vLLM - AIC Hit Ratio

panels.description: The tokens per second from compute, local CPU cache and AIC cache.
panels.title: Token Rate by Source

panels.description: Time-to-first-token latency from vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket; p50 and p99 quantiles over $__rate_interval.
panels.title: Time to First Token

panels.description: Requests per second for the vLLM run. A measure of total throughput based on average number of requests findishnig per second.
panels.title: Requests Completed per Second

panels.description: The total number of LMCache Store and Retrieve requests.
panels.title: LMCache Store and Retrieve Requests

panels.description: The read and write bandwidth into and out of the AIC KV Cache Storage.
panels.title: KV Cache Storage Bandwidth

panels.description: The total count of KV Cache Blocks on the AIC storage device.
panels.title: AIC KV Cache Block File Count

panels.description: The capacity remaining on the ROCm AIC storage system.
panels.title: AIC Free Capacity

panels.description: A time-based histogram of the AIS KV Cache Blocks and the number of times they have been "hit" as in retrieved by the KV Block Manager.
panels.title: KV Cache Block Hit Historgram

panels.description: The throughput reported by the AIS stats tool.
panels.title: AIS Stats - Throughput

panels.description: The latency of IO as reported by ais-stats.
panels.title: AIS Stats Latency

list.description: The node from which metrics have been obtained.
list.label: Instance
list.name: instance

list.description: The ID number of the target GPU in the target instance
list.label: GPU ID
list.name: gpu_id

title: ROCm(tm) AMD Infinity Context Dashboard
